marks.gloss_en: רמא להו מתניתין אברייתא -- the mishnah (only reclining makes one blessing for all) against the baraita (sitting to eat suffices)
ושני להו: כיון דאמרי ניזיל וניכול לחמא בדוך פלן -- כהסבו דמי (= p_nezil_kehesebu)
since they said 'let us go and eat bread in such-and-such a place', it is as if they reclined

שאלו את בן זומא: מפני מה אמרו... אמר להם: הואיל ואין בית הבליעה פנוי -- asked why wine during the meal is blessed by each for himself and after the meal by one for all, Ben Zoma gives the reason: the throat is not free
the mishnah: wine came to them during the meal -- each one blesses for himself; after the meal -- one blesses for all
אלא דעתיה למיכל, הכא נמי דעתיה לאורוחי
והא לא ארח? -- at the rising of the column he has not yet smelled anything; how can he bless?
ולטעמיך... אלא דעתיה למיכל, הכא נמי דעתיה לאורוחי -- as hamotzi precedes eating by intent to eat, so here intent to smell (= p_daato_learuchei)
Rava bar Yirmeya: from when does one bless over the scent? from when its column [of smoke] rises
over all incense one blesses 'who creates fragrant woods'
the baraita: one blesses 'who creates fragrant woods' only over the balsam of Rebbi's house, the balsam of Caesar's house, and myrtle anywhere
Rav Yehuda: over balsam oil one blesses 'who creates the oil of our land'
R' Yochanan: over balsam oil one blesses 'who creates pleasant oil'
Rav Adda bar Ahava: over this costus one blesses 'who creates fragrant woods'
the mishnah: if they reclined, one blesses [for them all]
מסייע ליה לרב -- the answer (he blesses over the incense because he washed first at the end) supports Rav: one who washes first at the end is designated for the blessing
Rav: one who washes his hands first at the end is designated for the blessing
מדקתני והוא אומר על המוגמר, מכלל דאיכא עדיף מיניה -- ואמאי! the wording implies someone else has precedence; why then does he say it?
the mishnah: and he [who blessed over the wine] says [the blessing] over the incense
הואיל והוא נטל ידיו תחלה באחרונה -- since he washed his hands first at the end (= p_hoil_natal_yadav)
since he washed his hands first at the end [of the meal] -- that is why he says the blessing over the incense
מיתיבי... להאיך לישנא דאמר רב לא שנו אלא פת דבעי הסבה אבל יין לא בעי הסבה -- קשיא רישא: the guests are only sitting, and yet each blesses over the wine for himself
שאני אורחין דדעתייהו למיעקר -- guests are different, for their mind is on moving on (= p_shani_orchin)
guests are different, for their mind is on moving on
ולהאיך לישנא דאמר רב לא שנו אלא פת דמהניא ליה הסבה אבל יין לא מהניא ליה הסבה -- קשיא סיפא: they reclined, and one blesses over the wine for all
שאני התם, דמגו דקא מהניא ליה הסבה לפת -- מהניא ליה הסבה ליין (= p_migo_pat)
there it is different: since reclining is effective for the bread, it is effective for the wine
Rav (version 2): [the mishnah] taught this only of bread
the baraita: [while seated] water is brought and each washes one hand; when they have gone up and reclined and water comes, though each washed one hand, he washes both hands again
